title: v1.0 Release Cut — Define the Line

sprint.goal: Stop the open-ended testing/cleanup expansion by drawing an explicit v1.0 line: ratify the must-ship feature set, confirm the quality gates are met, tag a release, and define what is explicitly out-of-scope (deferred to post-v1.0).
stories: S1: Ratify the v1.0 scope checklist (what must ship)
S2: Confirm quality gates (CI green, typecheck/lint clean, build clean)
S3: Tag and document the v1.0 release
S4: Publish the post-v1.0 backlog (deferred tracks)
sprint.demo_notes: A tagged v1.0 commit, a CHANGELOG/release note, and a post-v1.0 section in tracks.md listing every deferred track.
